name: Table
purpose: Presents tabular data with semantic rows and columns.
scenarios: Display a list of users with sortable columns
Show order line items with prices

columns.description: Column definitions with key, header, and optional render function.

states.name: default
states.description: Table is rendered with the provided rows.

antiPatterns: Do not use a table solely for layout; use Stack or AppShell.
Do not remove header cells from data tables.

keyboard: Arrow keys move between cells if interactive
a11y.focus: Cells are not individually focusable unless they contain interactive elements.
a11y.labeling: Caption or surrounding context labels the table; headers use scope=col.

responsive.strategy: Full table on desktop and tablet; compact scrolls horizontally. Card-list morph is contract-described only (demo pending), not implemented. Compact switch is container-driven via @container on the wrapper.

breakpoints.compact: Horizontal scroll within the component container if content overflows; reduced cell padding below the 48rem container threshold.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Text alignment and row order follow the document direction.

mechanics: Table renders semantic rows and columns. columns is Array<{ key, header, render? }>; rows is an array of objects keyed by column.key. caption is the accessible name. This is data, not layout — use Stack or AppShell for page chrome.
usage: Pass columns and rows. Add caption for the accessible name.
Keep header cells. Do not use Table only to position unrelated UI.

exports.name: Table
exports.description: Semantic data table with columns, rows, and caption.
